rows.section: IRS general rates, mainland (art. 68.º CIRS)
rows.basis: Taxable income (rendimento coletável), per year
rows.note: Current rates for 2026 income: Decreto-Lei n.º 212/2026, de 4 de novembro (Diário da República, 1.ª série, n.º 214, pp. 5-6, published 2026-11-04; promulgated 2026-11-02; in force from 2026-11-05, applying to income obtained from 2026-01-01). They replace the State Budget 2026 rates shown in the next table. Art. 68.º n.º 2: income above the first band is split, the top of the highest band it fills taxed at that band's average rate (column B) and the excess at the next marginal rate, which gives the same result as applying each marginal rate to its slice. Average rates at the top of each band: €8,342: 12.2%; €12,587: 13.212%; €17,838: 15.416%; €23,089: 17.277%; €29,397: 20.136%; €43,090: 24.732%; €46,566: 26.103%; €86,634: 34.658%. Madeira and the Azores apply their own reduced tables.

rows.section: Contractors: employment presumption, withholding on fees and receipts
rows.label: Official test: presumption of an employment contract (Código do Trabalho, art. 12.º)
rows.value: Employment is presumed when some of these are present: the work is done at a place belonging to or chosen by the client; the equipment and tools belong to the client; the worker keeps start and finish times set by the client; a fixed sum is paid at regular intervals for the work; the worker holds a management or supervisory role in the business

rows.section: Contractors: employment presumption, withholding on fees and receipts
rows.label: Sham self-employment
rows.value: Work that looks independent but has the features of an employment contract and may harm the worker or the State is a very serious offence of the employer; repeat offenders can lose public grants and tenders for up to two years

rows.section: Contractors: employment presumption, withholding on fees and receipts

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, self-employed, non-resident and property
rows.label: Corporate income tax (IRC) [national, with a municipal add-on]
rows.value: 19% general rate in 2026 (18% in 2027, 17% from 2028); 15% on the first €50,000 for SMEs; derrama estadual 3%, 5%, 9% on profit over €1,500,000; derrama municipal up to 1.5%; 15% global minimum tax for groups with revenue of at least €750,000,000; Madeira 13.3%. Paid by companies and permanent establishments of non-resident companies. Código do IRC, articles 87.º and 87.º-A; Lei n.º 64/2025; Lei n.º 73/2013, article 18.º; Lei n.º 41/2024.

rows.value: 21.4% on 70% of services or 20% of sales, declared quarterly; minimum €20 a month; base capped at 12 × IAS; contracting entities 7% or 10%. rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, self-employed, non-resident and property
rows.label: Simplified regimes (IRS and IRC regime simplificado; small-business exemption) [national]
rows.value: IRS: gross income up to €200,000, taxable share 15% to 95% by activity; IRC: income up to €200,000; VAT exemption up to €15,000 of turnover. Paid by self-employed people and small companies that use them. Código do IRS, articles 28.º and 31.º; Código do IRC, articles 86.º-A and 86.º-B; Código do IVA, article 53.º.

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, self-employed, non-resident and property
rows.label: Non-resident tax on employment income [national]
rows.value: 25% final withholding on gross pay, nothing on pay up to the minimum wage from a single payer; EU and EEA residents can claim a refund down to the general scale; resident after more than 183 days or with a usual home. Paid by non-resident employees (withheld by the employer). Código do IRS, articles 16.º and 71.º.

rows.label: Property tax: IMI and AIMI (imposto municipal sobre imóveis) [municipal (AIMI national)]
rows.value: IMI: urban property 0.3% to 0.45% set by each municipality, rustic 0.8%; AIMI: 0.7% to 1.5% for individuals above €600,000, 0.4% for companies. Paid by owners of property on 1 January. Código do IMI, articles 112.º and 135.º-A to 135.º-I.

rows.label: Property transfer tax (IMT) and stamp duty on purchases [municipal (rates set nationally)]
rows.value: homes: 0% to 8% by bracket, then a single 6% or 7.5%; IMT Jovem exemption up to €330,539; 7.5% for non-resident buyers of homes; 6.5% other urban property; stamp duty 0.8%. Paid by the buyer. Código do IMT, articles 9.º and 17.º; Tabela Geral do Imposto do Selo, verba 1.1.
